test_title: PYST 50: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 04 Sept, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

Statements:

All mugs are cups.

Some mugs are forks.

Conclusions:

(I): Some cups are forks.

(II): Some forks are mugs.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follow.
Neither conclusion I nor II follow

solution:

Conclusions:

(I): Some cups are forks.- True (All mugs are cups.Some mugs are forks.Some cups are forks is a true)

(II): Some forks are mugs. - True ( All Mugs are Cups. Some Mugs are Forks. Some forks are mugs is a true)

Both conclusions I and II follow. 

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2"**
